what_it_does: HP-MDR adds support for GPU-accelerated (graphics processing unit) compression and decompression of scientific data. Existing systems compress data on CPUs (central processing units), wasting the powerful compute hardware available in modern graphics cards. This work enables progressive retrieval—you can get lower-quality versions of data quickly before requesting the full high-quality version. It also lets users control how much error or loss of precision they're willing to accept during compression.
